reviews.body:
Hey @pcbeingused333 👋

Thanks for fixing the macOS Ignored Volumes matching so a list like "Macintosh HD, Recovery" hides every named volume, and for adding regression coverage around that case 🔥

Here's everything I found in this pass:

**Blocking**
- [ ] **Please remove dev/test material from the extension folder and keep it in your own repo.** Store installs only need the extension itself plus `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `media/` and `metadata/`.
  - [ ] `test/ignored-volumes.test.ts`
  - [ ] the `test` script in `package.json`

  > As mentioned in our [docs here ↗](https://developers.raycast.com/basics/prepare-an-extension-for-store#readme)

When the blocking items are done, request another review 😊

Feel free to reach me here or on [Slack](https://www.raycast.com/community) if anything is unclear.

<details>
<summary>📋 Quick checkout commands</summary>

```bash
BRANCH="fix/single-disk-eject-trim-ignored-volumes"
FORK_URL="https://github.com/pcbeingused333/extensions.git"
EXTENSION_NAME="single-disk-eject"
REPO_NAME="extensions"

git clone -n --depth=1 --filter=tree:0 -b $BRANCH $FORK_URL
cd $REPO_NAME
git sparse-checkout set --no-cone "extensions/$EXTENSION_NAME"
git checkout
cd "extensions/$EXTENSION_NAME"
npm install && npm run dev
```

</details>

We're currently experiencing a high volume of incoming requests. As a result, the initial review may take up to 15 business days.

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Low impact]** This PR appears safe to merge; no blocking issues were found.

Summary

This PR fixes ignored volume names on macOS by trimming spaces around each comma-separated entry and dropping empty entries. - macOS hides ignored volumes even when names follow commas. No new actionable issues were found.
